author: Stealthbomber16
body:
Stone Sword
Gold Chestplate

+ Stone sword inflicts slowness 1 for 5 seconds
+ Immune to fire damage
- Stone sword inflicts fire resistance for 5 seconds
- Powers not in effect until 30 seconds alive.

The aquamancer is a versatile support class that works well running with a group to ambush. The chase opportunities given by the class is balanced by the damage output and armor. Its powers not being in effect until 30 seconds alive makes it a very bad defensive character.

replies.author: Stealthbomber16
replies.body:
The goal of this class is to be able to run with a group of 3-5 people and take down people, while having bonus ability to survive against fire classes (such as inferno) and have amazing chase ability. Its not very complicated to me.

If you want you can remove the enemies hit by sword receive fire resistance. I just added that because it makes sense.
